name: model_box_gen
describe: Entity ModelBox baking: from (texU,texV,x,y,z,dx,dy,dz,delta,mirror,texW,texH) build the 8 box corner vertices (delta inflate + mirror x-swap), the 6 faces' UV mapping (int texcoords / sheet size), and each face's draw() normal (Vec3d cross+normalize, MathHelper.sqrt float precision, -0.0 ctor norm). mirror flipFace reverses each quad (UV order + normal sign). GL emit dropped. Pure.
